items.title_display: HOMESITES AND CARE & MAINTENANCE OF PREMISES
items.heading_src: VI. HOMESITES AND CARE & MAINTENANCE OF PREMISES
paragraphs: VI. HOMESITES AND CARE & MAINTENANCE OF PREMISES

G. All homes and homesites must be maintained in a clean, orderly, and well-kept condition. This includes, but is not limited to, the exterior appearance of the home, general upkeep, necessary repairs, painting, grounds maintenance, and pest control. If a home or homesite is found to be in a state of disrepair or neglect, management reserves the right pursuant to Paragraph 22 of the Master Form Exclusive Right of Possession Agreement to require the shareholder to take corrective action. Should the shareholder fail to do so in a timely manner, management may perform the necessary work or engage third party contractors to complete the required maintenance or repairs. The shareholder will be responsible for the reasonable costs incurred. When park personnel perform such services, a service fee of $50 per hour, per worker, shall be charged with a one hour minimum per occurrence.
You'll notice this is just one of many regulations for care and maintenance.  Go to the full document to learn more care and maintenance points
